title: Outreach Pricing in 2026: No Public Package Price, Voice Plans From $10
summary: Outreach publishes no price for its four Amplify packages. Its Voice calling plans are public: $10 or $20 per user a month for US and Canada calls.
body_markdown:
Outreach does not publish a price for its platform. Its pricing page lists four packages, Amplify Essentials, Amplify Core, Amplify Plus and Amplify Pro, each with a Request pricing button and 10,000 to 100,000 AI credits. The price combines a fee per user with those credits. Outreach does publish its Outreach Voice calling plans: $10 per user a month for 1,000 US and Canada minutes, or $20 for unlimited. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a dialer that works inside Outreach. Every Outreach detail below comes from Outreach's own pricing page, Outreach Voice pricing page, support site and Terms of Service, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No Outreach account was used and nothing was tested. For the calling routes inside Outreach, see[how to make calls from Outreach](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-make-calls-from-outreach) .


## Outreach pricing at a glance


Outreach's[pricing page](https://www.outreach.ai/pricing) now sits at outreach.ai, and the old outreach.io address redirects there. It says to "reach out to our team for custom pricing" and shows no dollar amount for any package.

Calling is priced on a separate page. Outreach's[Outreach Voice pricing page](https://www.outreach.ai/outreach-voice-pricing) says the option to enable the dialer is included in the platform, and that customers who use it pay for voice minutes and phone numbers. The plan cards on that page show these prices.

## What changes the real cost of Outreach


The package price comes from a quote. These are the parts Outreach's pages name.


### Seats plus AI credits


The pricing page says Outreach combines two models: seat-based access, paid for each user, and AI credits, paid by use. Credits pay for AI work such as research, personalized emails, conversation analysis and forecasting. Each action, such as generating one message, has a set credit cost. The page does not print those costs.


The page says extra credit packs can be bought at any time and gives no price. Outreach's[Amplify Package FAQ](https://support.outreach.io/support/solutions/articles/159000425192-amplify-package-faq) says Amplify is licensed for the whole org, and that admins get emails at 50%, 80% and 100% of credits used, plus an overage notice at 102%. A second[support article](https://support.outreach.io/support/solutions/articles/159000432352-can-i-setup-per-user-ai-credit-limits-or-is-it-total-account-wide-) says credits are bought and managed for the whole account, with no hard limit per user.


### Which package has the features you need


All four packages list the Outreach Voice Integrated Dialer. Amplify Essentials is built around conversation intelligence and coaching, and its feature list does not include sequences. Multi-channel sequences start at Amplify Core. Forecasting is on Amplify Pro only.


### Calling minutes


The Outreach Voice pricing page says minutes are connected time only, and each call is rounded up to the nearest minute. When a user bridges the call through an external phone, the minutes used are doubled. Outreach's[dialing methods article](https://support.outreach.io/support/solutions/articles/159000425815-outreach-voice-dialing-phone-or-computer-overview) describes calling from the computer as the more economical route.


A calling plan is applied per user, one plan each. Minutes beyond a plan's limit are billed at the pay-per-minute rates. Outreach's[Terms of Service](https://www.outreach.ai/terms) define normal commercial use as up to 3,000 minutes per user a month, and say Outreach may charge for use above that, including on unlimited plans.


### Phone numbers


The two US plans include one US or Canada number. Other numbers are billed by use at a rate that depends on the country. The page also describes a Shared Phone Numbers Plan for the US and Canada, a pool of numbers for the Local Dial feature, without a price. The terms say Outreach may reclaim a number that goes unused for 60 days.


### Add-ons, services and support


The pricing page FAQ names four add-ons: Data Sharing, Connectors, Additional Instances and Listener Licenses. None has a published price. It says professional services packages for onboarding are quoted, and the support FAQ calls them highly recommended. The FAQ says Plus support is included with Amplify Core and managed services with Amplify Pro.


### Contract terms


Outreach's Terms of Service, last updated April 12, 2024, say the initial term is set in the order. After that the agreement renews automatically for 12 months at a time, unless the order says otherwise. Either party can stop the renewal with written notice at least 30 days before the term ends.


The terms say orders are non-cancelable and non-refundable, and that fees are due when the services start unless the order form says otherwise. Seats added mid-term are invoiced at the then-current price, pro-rated. After the initial term, Outreach can change fees with at least 60 days' notice before a renewal term. The pages state no seat minimum, so ask for one in writing.


## Who Outreach fits and who it does not


Outreach calls itself the AI Agent Platform for revenue teams. Its pricing page says Amplify Essentials and Amplify Core are for teams getting started, that mid-sized teams fit Amplify Plus, and that CROs typically choose Amplify Pro for forecasting across the organization. That fits a team that wants sequences, conversation intelligence, deal management and forecasting from one vendor.


Outreach is a weaker fit for a buyer who needs a public price to build a budget, or who wants to buy a seat online the same day. Every package leads to a sales conversation. It is also a weaker fit for a team that only wants a dialer, because the dialer comes inside a platform package.


Outreach's own dialing mode for call tasks is[Sequential Dialing](https://support.outreach.io/support/solutions/articles/159000429165-configure-sequential-dialing) . It tries each of a prospect's numbers in turn, then moves to the next call task. A team that wants several numbers called at once adds another dialer on top.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Outreach cost?


Outreach does not publish a price for its packages. Its pricing page says the cost depends on team size, the AI workflows in use and the capabilities required, and each package has a Request pricing button.


### What are the Outreach pricing packages?


There are four: Amplify Essentials with 10,000 AI credits, Amplify Core with 25,000, Amplify Plus with 50,000 and Amplify Pro with 100,000. Essentials centers on conversation intelligence and coaching. Core adds sequences. Pro adds forecasting.


### How much does Outreach Voice cost?


Outreach's Voice pricing page shows US Standard at $10 per user a month for 1,000 US and Canada minutes, and US Premium at $20 for unlimited minutes. Both include one US or Canada number. Europe plans run from $15 to $40 per user a month.


### How long is an Outreach contract?


The order sets the initial term. Outreach's Terms of Service say the agreement then renews automatically for 12 months at a time, unless either party gives written notice at least 30 days before the term ends. Orders are non-cancelable and non-refundable.


### Does Outreach have a free trial?


Outreach's pricing page lists no free trial and no free plan. Each package offers Request pricing, and the page's other button is Get a demo.
